dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a natural number n, this abbreviates the type of n-by-n real matrices, represented as Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the type of A, dA, Q, R, Rinv, and every matrix expression in the proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines E(A,dA,R) = (((R^T R - A^T A) - A^T dA) - dA^T A) - dA^T dA, with all products being matrix products and all subtractions being pointwise matrix subtractions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the central matrix occurring between Rinv^T and Rinv on the right-hand side of the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the n-by-n identity matrix I_n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the hypothesis R Rinv = I_n and in the left-hand side I_n - Q^T Q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is ordinary finite-dimensional matrix multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms Q R, R Rinv, all Gram-type products such as Q^T Q and R^T R, and the right-hand-side product (Rinv^T E) Rinv.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: For Q, it defines the matrix I_n - Q^T Q.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is exactly the left-hand side of the asserted equality and measures the exact orthogonality defect of Q.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: It maps a matrix to its transpose.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies Q^T, Rinv^T, R^T, A^T, and dA^T in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines the difference of Gram matrices R^T R - A^T A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the first term in the left-associated definition of E(A,dA,R).

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is propositional equality between two objects of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Both hypotheses and the conclusion are exact matrix equalities, not approximate relations.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite type of natural-number indices strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes the rows and columns of every matrix and supplies the finite index set over which matrix-product sums are taken.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: It invokes the addition operation supplied by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With the matrix addition instance used here, it makes A + dA in the first hypothesis ordinary pointwise matrix addition.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines matrix addition pointwise from scalar addition: (X + Y)_{ij} = X_{ij} + Y_{ij}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the exact meaning of A + dA in Q R = A + dA.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the type of natural numbers, including zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The quantified natural number n determines the common matrix dimension, with no assumption that n is positive.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: It is the type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All matrix entries and all scalar arithmetic in the proposition are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies ordinary addition on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It induces the entrywise addition used in the matrix sum A + dA.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: It converts an ordinary homogeneous Add operation into an HAdd operation with the same addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that the elaborated HAdd expression applied to A and dA is ordinary matrix addition.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: It equips Fin n with its finite enumeration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It allows every matrix product to be defined by a finite sum over the intermediate index j in Fin n.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: It invokes the multiplication operation supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Through the matrix HMul instance, every occurrence represented by LocalDef004 is interpreted as standard matrix multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It invokes the subtraction operation supplied by an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It implements the successive matrix subtractions in E(A,dA,R) and the subtraction I_n - Q^T Q.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: A matrix with row type m, column type n, and entries in alpha is a function m -> n -> alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Thus the target concerns functions Fin n -> Fin n -> Real, and its matrix equalities are exact extensional equalities of their entries.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.instHMulOfFintypeOfMulOfAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines standard matrix multiplication by (X Y)_{ik} = sum over j of X_{ij} Y_{jk}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes the meaning of every product in the hypotheses, the Gram matrices, and the final sandwich product.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.one
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines the identity matrix as the diagonal matrix having scalar one on the diagonal and zero off the diagonal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the matrix I_n used by LocalDef003.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.sub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It defines matrix subtraction pointwise from scalar subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines every subtraction in I_n - Q^T Q and in the expanded matrix E(A,dA,R).

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.transpose
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a matrix X, its transpose satisfies (X^T)_{ij} = X_{ji}.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines all transposed factors in the asserted identity.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: It interprets a natural-number literal in a type having the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the literal 1 used to construct the identity matrix and its diagonal scalar entries.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: It derives interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's distinguished One element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the literal 1 in LocalDef003 denote matrix one and the diagonal literal 1 denote real scalar one.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies the real numbers with their additive commutative monoid structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides finite addition and zero for the dot-product sums defining matrix multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the scalar products X_{ij}Y_{jk} summed in each matrix-product entry.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies the real scalar one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the diagonal entries of the identity matrix I_n.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies ordinary real subtraction, implemented as addition of the additive inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It induces the pointwise matrix subtraction used throughout the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: It supplies the real scalar zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the off-diagonal entries of I_n and the additive zero used in finite matrix-product sums.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: It decides equality between two indices in Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It allows the diagonal identity matrix to distinguish diagonal entries from off-diagonal entries.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: It converts an ordinary homogeneous Sub operation into an HSub operation with the same subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that each elaborated HSub expression is ordinary pointwise matrix subtraction.

binders: An arbitrary natural number n, implicitly quantified and allowed to be zero.
Arbitrary n-by-n real matrices A, dA, Q, R, and Rinv.
hypotheses: R Rinv = I_n exactly; thus Rinv is supplied as a right inverse of R.
conclusions: I_n - Q^T Q = (Rinv^T E(A,dA,R)) Rinv, where E(A,dA,R) = (((R^T R - A^T A) - A^T dA) - dA^T A) - dA^T dA.
mathematical_definitions: Every matrix belongs to R^{n x n} and has entries indexed by pairs i,j in Fin n.
For matrices X and Y, (X Y)_{ik} = sum_{j in Fin n} X_{ij}Y_{jk}.
Matrix addition and subtraction are entrywise.
I_n is the n-by-n identity matrix, with real one on its diagonal and zero elsewhere.
E(A,dA,R) is the left-associated expression (((R^T R - A^T A) - A^T dA) - dA^T A) - dA^T dA.
The quantity I_n - Q^T Q is an exact matrix, not a norm or scalar error measure.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every natural dimension n and all n-by-n real matrices A, dA, Q, R, and Rinv, if Q times R equals A plus dA and R times Rinv is the identity matrix, then the exact orthogonality-defect matrix I_n - Q^T Q equals Rinv^T times the matrix (((R^T R - A^T A) - A^T dA) - dA^T A) - dA^T dA, followed by multiplication on the right by Rinv.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The dimension n is not required to be positive. For n = 0, Fin 0 is empty and there is only one 0-by-0 real matrix, so the equalities are degenerate and automatically true.
The proposition is conditional: for matrix choices that do not satisfy both displayed hypotheses, no conclusion is asserted.
Rinv is universally supplied as data; the proposition does not existentially assert that an inverse exists.
Only R Rinv = I_n is explicitly assumed. The opposite-sided equality Rinv R = I_n is not encoded as a hypothesis, even though it follows mathematically for finite square real matrices.
The name dA imposes no mathematical restriction: dA is arbitrary and is not assumed small, bounded, structured, or nonzero.
Q is not assumed orthogonal. The conclusion instead gives an exact formula for I_n - Q^T Q.
No triangularity condition on R, rank condition on A, positivity condition, determinant condition, or other matrix structure is explicitly stated.
All matrices are square and have the same dimension; the proposition does not cover a rectangular factorization.
There are no norms, inequalities, error bounds, tolerances, floating-point operations, rounding models, or approximation claims.
All arithmetic and all equalities are exact over the real numbers.
There are no existential witnesses, uniqueness claims, or computed scalar constants beyond the zero and one used in the identity matrix.
